notes.title: Arise from Shadows - Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Cave Crawlers, here is the third post-release patch, we are still investigating some issues that need time to resolve, but here are the fixes and additions made:

Bug fixes:
- The text during the intro cutscene will no longer fit into the floor/walls depending on the orientation of the camera
- The intro cinematic will no longer play again if you save and load your game in the tutorial scene
- The edges of the Controls category were too dark and hid the menu bar, this is no longer the case
- A bug causing the toad's damage area to not be equal to its visual index is resolved.
- The regeneration of damage taken in the light will be done gradually.
- Some shadows areas in zone 3 (aerial part) did not allow the player to regenerate
- The visual cues for taking progressive damage in the light will begin as soon as damage is taken, they arrived very late which made the mechanic difficult to understand
- Some checkpoints have been added to prevent the player from having to go back really far
- A breach in zone 1 and one in zone 3 (aerial part) have been blocked


Known issues:
- Unfortunately, in some cases players can still encounter Death Chains, we are working on this to reduce their number.
- Weird camera rotation may be applied if you save in animal form and then come back (to fix this, until we fix the issue, you can unpossess the creature/possess a new one)
- Some voices and subtitles may not be correctly synchronized


The demo has been updated with all mentioned fixes. We will come back at the beginning of the year with a new patch, until then, we wish you happy holidays.

Thank you for your patience!🙏

notes.title: Arise from Shadows - Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=RDRx7AXMRc0;full][/previewyoutube]Cave Crawlers, here is the second post-release patch, beyond the usual fixes related to bugs, the updates at the beginning of the month also bring new features and a rebalancing of those already present:

Additions & balancing:
- From now on, players will see a circle delimiting the area of ​​damage that the toad does to them, no more unfair deaths! In addition to that, the toad's light will flicker a little earlier, indicating that we are getting dangerously close to it.
- Following feedback, the Dash range has been slightly increased to be a little more permissive.
- The tutorial environment has been revised to guide the player a little better.
- An increase in the overall light intensity has been made.

Known issues:
- Unfortunately, in some cases players may still encounter "DeathChains", we are working on this and reducing their number.
- Weird camera rotation may be applied if you save in animal form and then come back (to fix this, until we fix the issue, you can dispossess the creature/regain possession of a new one)
- Some voices and subtitles may not be correctly synchronized.
- The control scheme in the menu is completely black and blocks the visibility of the options


These additions are also coming to the demo!

The team is still working on other issues in the meantime, the next hotfix patch is coming mid-month.
Thank you for your patience!🙏

notes.title: Arise from Shadow - Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Cave Crawlers, here is the first post release patch, we're still investigating on some issues that need time to solve, but here are fixes and first additions :

BugFixes : 
[list]
[*] The player will no longer spawn as a creature in the in-game menu
[*] We fixed a problem where players were unable to unpossess creatures after saving under creature and then loading back
[*] We added the Haptic turn on/off feature
[*] Subtitles will no longer be hovered by HUD indicators (such as sprint/dash) 
[*] We balanced the in game voice acting as it was too weak, it now be a lot more audible
[*] We fixed the damage sound taken when hit by light with Axolotl & Rodent, causing them to repeat every frame causing a very loudy weird noise
[/list]

Known Issues : 
[list]
[*] Sadly, on some cases, player may still encounter deathchains, we're working on it and reducing their numbers
[*] A weird camera rotation can be applied if you're saving in animal form and then coming back (to solve, until we fix it, you can unpossess the creature / repossessing a new one)
[*] Some voices and subtitles may be not correctly synchronized
[/list]

The demo will be updated with a new available area replacing the previous one, more restricted, but more passable for players.

The team is still working on other issues in the meantime, just for you to know, we'll deploy a new patch every two weeks, one minor (like this one) and one major, at the beginning of each months. Thank you for your patience!🙏

notes.title: Final release day! Yay!
notes.content:
Hello cavecrawlers! 
We are proud to announce the Final Release of [b]Arise from Shadows[/b]! 

We want to thanks everyone involved in the project, from the early builds to Kickstarter backers, and our small but growing community. Even after a failed Kickstarter Campaign, we managed to get on Steam, and have a playable, enjoyable game. Thanks to all of you, we also managed to get a small but active community, and it means a lot to us at Digital Pourpre.


As you know since the Steam Next fest, and for the next few months, we will be releasing patches and will continue to focus on bugfixes here and there. We still need your feedback on the forums to deploy bugfixes in time. From your benchmarks to your headsets, the more data we get, the more fixes we can make!

Also, we are release the [b]Game's OST sound[/b], made by Nicolas, our friend and coworker. Priced at [b]3,99 euros[/b], it's a small price for a masterpiece !
You can find his work here : https://soundcloud.com/lahondesn


[b]Digital Pourpre also wants to remind that[/b]:

-The game is compatible and have been tested with HTC Vive, Vive Cosmos, Rift/Rift S, Quest, Quest 2, Pico 4 and Valve Index
-Our current and definitive pricetag will be [b]19.99€[/b]. It will not change after ou Early Access
-Our bugfixes and patches will continue over the following weeks, thanks to you all.

Digital Pourpre Studio

[b]Bugfixes already deployed:[/b]

-New & Easier possession mechanic : we improved visual feedbacks and simplified the mechanic, now you need to orient the controller in the right direction and the blue orb will turn on & your controller haptic will be activated.
-We're aware that the previous model was really difficult to understand, that's why we also added a quick explanation of the new model on the first creature encounter.
-Steam Achievements should now be properly unlocked.
-Collisions and breaches fixed.
-Fixed an exploit in the form of a bird allowing you to exit the map
-Fixed and improved the management of health loss in aerial form
-Added missing voice dialogues on some stelaes
-Fixed visual damage indicator when a creature is possessed
-Updated shadows and aerial part of Zone 3 (called Feather Way), issues with the area are resolved

Known bugs:
-The movement of certain creatures lacks polish.
-There may be compatibility issues with some headsets like the HP Reverb 2 and Quest 3.
-Some lag or delays can happen when switching zones.

notes.title: Stelaes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42844340/efad18309c7de603e4ef20f047e8039173cc882c.png[/img]
Those weirdly shaped blocks are kinda sentient. Touching them will animate them briefly, and you'll hear wispers from the past. 

Old stories long forgotten, testimonies from a long time ago are told trough them. Crafters of those stelaes are long time gone, but some of their tales still live in the stone.

 Hidden in the ruined halls of the ancient dwellers, behind strong doors, it's their legacy to the new dwellers from this age. Like you, they didn't see the light of the sun in a long time.

notes.title: Nightrunner
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42844340/5d578ee0dfaf04a0a110d27a599f38ad4f42370f.png[/img]
Lurking in the shadows, hidden in the bushes, nightrunners are solitary hunters. Preying on small creatures, notably the rat, they walk silently, getting closer before jumping on their prey. 

Once they got a prey in sight, they gave him a chase for a bit, and if you don't flee fast, you'll end as their meal.

But even those predator have weaknesses, being sometimes too large to follow the rodents into their nests. Being a quite common predator in the caves, always stay on your guard when you see their movement in the dark.

And when you see their bright blue eyes, RUN!

Tomorrow, we are doing some archeology! See you soon!

notes.title: Canyons and Bugfixes!
notes.content:
Those arid cliffs are the canyons, the only part of the overworld you'll probably see. Once there, the sun will be your main concern. Shadows are scarce, and your only allies will be the birds. Using them to get to the other side of the canyon will be your main objective in this time limited race against the clock. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hQU1FOe.gif[/img]

Getting outside is a challenge, but you'll probably need to get out during your journey. Not every cave gets you deeper, sometimes you need to think outside the box to go deeper!

[b]About future content[/b]:

-We finally launched, and we are deploying bugfixes since then. 
-The main goal is reworking a little the signs and feedbacks of the possession mechanics. 
-Some asked about an English voice acted version, we will probably get a voice actor later, once we fixed most of the bugs reported during the feedback phase. 

Thanks for all your support everyone!


-[b]Digital Pourpre Studio[/b]

notes.title: The Bird
notes.content:
Stuck in front a deep chasm with no where else to go? The birds can give you an hand or, you know a wing...

 Flying over the fast emptiness of canyon, free from any sort of danger... except from direct sunlight. You only have limited time flying, because your health drops quickly under the sun. Birds are mostly found on the cliffs near the cave entrances, and easy to spot. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/086y92T.gif[/img]

Our birds can also be found in some caves, mosty those connected to the overworld. Maybe there's a reason they are found in both places? They could probably help you reach new paths on your adventures!

Stay tuned for our next post, the Canyons!

notes.title: Moray Eels
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42844340/f012d5dcce3b27572d5903a0a3f0ccb45126552d.png[/img]

Those bony fishes swim in the deeper parts of the underwaters parts of the caves. Hunting for axolotls and fishes, their predatory instincts fortunately lack the intelligence to check alguaes and the flora.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eE1cvAv.gif[/img]

Using this to their advantage, axolotls can survive another day. Their dark skin allows them to blend into the poorly lit lakes and rivers that sprawls underground. Giving chase to their prey, they swim fast enough to catch even the fastest fishes. Hidding from moray eels is the only chance of survival underwater, so stay sharp!

notes.title: Axolotls
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42844340/0ab0d1230792b57d8e353a1c2fc26e9456eaed00.png[/img]

Mostly hidden in algaes or corals, our amphibian friends are the fastest swimmers in the underground tunnels. Brightly colored, cute and friendly, Axolotls can be found on the shores of the water filled caves, safe from the dangerous moray eels, their natural predators. To escape moray eels, you can hide in the bright algaes, or try your luck at evading them by swimming fast! But be carefull, those predators are quite dangerous!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yc2RJSj.gif[/img]

With enough strenght to push objects; and fast enough to escape jaws of the eels, they are your best allies in your underwater journey!

notes.title: Aquatic Caverns
notes.content:
Those underground lakes and rivers are part of the aquactic caverns. Inhabited mostly by aquatic fauna, they also have one of the most dangerous predators. 

Dash between islands to avoid water, or try to find something that can swim to possess! Don't be amazed by the colors of the different iridescent corals or the cuteness of axolots, you are in a dangerous place. 

Moray eels wander the area, the are hungry, and seek axolotl meat. Unfortunately, you also seek axolotls to get deeper in the caves. At least in control of axolotls, you can hide yourself from moray eels in alguaes.

Stay tuned for tomorrow! We will talk about our cute axolotls!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U2U4tYD.gif[/img]

notes.title: Ruins of Lore
notes.content:
You'll stumble upon ruins on your way. Who build them ? And where are their inhabitants ? Those massive corridors made of large stone blocks or mined directly seem quite ancient. What lies behind the massive doors and what are those stelaes scatered randomly inside ? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42844340/e708fc78ed61b67a9d40543fa54021ee1ea34ab1.png[/img]

When walking in those underground passages, that's probably most of the question you will ask yourself. But stay on your guard, who know wich danger lurks in the shadows, waiting for some prey ? Maybe this ancient civilisation vanished for a reason that still wander silently in the ruins. Who knows ?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42844340/1cf7054d7c31d980a528b55fd505131101e37d1b.png[/img]

notes.title: Lantern Toads
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZQaWaGA.gif[/img]

Lantern toads are quite strange creatures, maybe the weirdest you will meet on your journey. Emitting bright light from their bulbous appendage, you should avoid direct contact with them, even if they aren't hostile, lantern toads can hurt you.
Wandering randomly near the shores or in the damp caves, their light betray their presence. Quite gluttonous, lantern toads eat fireflies, their favorite meal. When they see those, the follow them indefinetly, until they can take a bite. While not a danger per see, they can be quite cumbersome in small corridors.

notes.title: Creatures: The Rat
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NusJ5TG.png[/img]

Those small rodents are everywhere. Hidden in the smallest caves, behind rocks or under mushrooms; they are an easy find. Once possessed, they'll allow you to go through smaller spaces and continue your journey.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kjoaavI.gif[/img]

Don't worry, our rats are friendly, they don't bite or scratch! During your exploration of the tunnels, you may find yourself hunted. Feeling something lurking in the shadows, in the corners of corridors. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BnAhUet.gif[/img]

The nightrunners are their main predators of our little rodents, and they want a taste of them. Your best bet would be to flee rapidly in another hole, or hide yourself if you can!

notes.title: Our Start: The Caverns
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mgJ65vG.png[/img]

Long dark tunnels stretching below the surface. Most of them are inhabited by creatures. Some friendly, other not so much.Inside the caves you will probably find ruins, lightshrooms and darkness. Your journey will lead you through obstacles, doors and puzzles. If you end stuck somewhere, using possession on the friendly fauna can lead you to new areas. Don't worry, even lost, you can easily find your way back on your own.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YmeIY4f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Possess to Progress
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uy4KoC2.png[/img]

Caves are populated with different kind of creatures, some with strenghts and others with weaknesses. Surviving through those environnement allowed them to develop features, like flying, or swimming. With this, you will be able to overcome obstacles on your way. Through possession, you will be able to control and use those features to go deeper in the caves. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/D2vQ3zI.gif[/img]
[i]Before possessing, the player will have to play a minigame, to fill the possession bar in a short lapse of time.[/i]

Finding a subterreanean lake? Catch an Axolot. Stuck at deep chasm or tall underground cliffs? Possess the nearby birds. Each creature has it's own features, giving you nearly no limits, be it the air, the floor, or water.

notes.title: Doors and Puzzles
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cQQDMfP.png[/img]

Some caves are blocked by massives doors. And doors need keys. 

With the help of your abilities, notably the possession one, you'll be able to find strange cubes. That's the keystones you're looking after! 
Sometimes really well hidden in the darkest parts of the many underground chambers, or in plain sight in inaccessible parts, you'll need your abilities to get them. 

Those puzzles make you use the different strengths of each creature in their environment, allowing you to progress further.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jGR3mXn.gif[/img]

notes.title: A Specter on the Water
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rITCsGq.gif[/img]

You woke up in a cavern, deep under the overworld. You don't know who, nor where you are. The only thing you know for sure, you died. How did you passed away? You don't know either. As a specter, you can walk freely, even dash in those deep caves.

Now with your ghostly abilities, you can go faster and farther than before, in a blink. Allowing you to cross streams, small chasms etc.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/b3n6FrW.gif[/img]

But one danger remains.

Direct sunlight, or bright lights can arm, or kill you if you stay enough in direct contact. But something changed in you, you can now control, possess, the living. 

Those small creatures will give you a chance to leave those caves, and maybe discover what caused your death?
